title: Minimal bounded finite free models over a local ring
statement: Let R be a commutative local ring. Let C be a cochain complex of R-modules [def-pc-derived-category] supported between integers a and b, whose terms are finite free [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. There is a cochain complex D with the same support bounds and finite free terms, homotopy equivalent to C, such that every differential of D has image in the maximal ideal times its target. This records the already proved adopted-source minimal-complex theorem.

source.place: Tag 00MT, finite iteration of unit cancellation

proof.text: If a differential is nonzero modulo the maximal ideal, choose a nonzero matrix coefficient. It is a unit. Choose x and a linear form phi with phi(d(x))=1. The map G(y)=phi(y)x satisfies GdG=G and gives a null-homotopic idempotent chain map P. Its kernel subcomplex is homotopy equivalent to the original. The kernel terms are direct summands, hence finite projective and free over the local ring. These constructions are proved in the same adopted module.

Induct on the sum of term ranks over the finite support interval. Each cancellation lowers this sum and preserves the support interval. At termination every differential has image in the maximal ideal times its target. Compose the homotopy equivalences. The adopted Lean proof uses the equivalent split idempotent kernel construction and exactly this rank induction.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_homotopyEquiv_isMinimal (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{v} A) ℤ) (a b : ℤ)
    [M.IsStrictlyGE a] [M.IsStrictlyLE b] [∀ i, Module.Free A (M.X i)]
    [∀ i, Module.Finite A (M.X i)] :
    ∃ M' : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{v} A) ℤ, M'.IsMinimal ∧ M'.IsStrictlyGE a ∧
      M'.IsStrictlyLE b ∧ (∀ i, Module.Free A (M'.X i)) ∧ (∀ i, Module.Finite A (M'.X i)) ∧
      Nonempty (HomotopyEquiv M M')
